Aubergine With Ground Beef
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:14pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 pounds Ground beef
1 medium Onion, diced
1/2 cup Bread crumbs
Salt and pepper to taste
1/2 cup Tomato sauce
1 Sprinkle of parsley
1 Aubergine

Preparation

1 Peel aubergine and cut into thin slices. Brown ground beef; add diced onion. 2 Add 1/2 cup bread crumbs, tomato sauce, parsley, salt, pepper and 2 tablespoons grated cheese. Layer aubergine, ground beef mixture, aubergine, ground beef, etc. Cook in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes.
